# 2 Baruch Chapter 18 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** First Fast and Vision

---

**18:1** And the Lord said to me: "Hear me, O Baruch, and I will speak to you, and you shall take to heart my words.

**18:2** For if Adam first sinned and brought untimely death upon all, yet of those who were born from him, each one of them has prepared for his own soul torment to come, and again each one of them has chosen for himself the glories that are to come. For assuredly he who believes shall receive recompense."

---

*SOPHIA notes: LOGOS base throughout. "Untimely death" (v.2) preserved over PNEUMA's "premature death" — "untimely" is the more precise theological term for death as a premature intrusion into creation. "Assuredly he who believes shall receive recompense" preserved — this is the chapter's climactic promise.*
